case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date
tests: Checks that the agent asks for the missing event date rather than guessing, omitting it or leaving a placeholder; the completed flyer is graded after the supplied answer.

checks.name: asks first (The date of the pottery workshop.)

got.question: What event date should appear on the flyer?

faults.what: The oversized 'Beginners welcome' text overlaps the bowl illustration, obscuring its upper section and making the layout look unfinished.
The text block is cramped horizontally, with 'Beginners welcome' almost touching both edges and little typographic hierarchy between the headline and event details.

judge.summary: The flyer contains all the correct wording in an earthy portrait design, but oversized text crowds the edges and overlaps the bowl illustration.

must_haves.item: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.
The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
must_haves.why: Both appear with the requested wording and time punctuation.

must_haves.item: The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
must_haves.why: The phrase is present, and there is no wording beyond the five requested text elements.

must_haves.item: The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.
must_haves.why: The 4:5 portrait flyer uses cream, muted olive-grey, and terracotta bowl linework.

must_haves.item: All event details are legible and uncropped.
must_haves.why: All wording is readable and within the image, although the welcome line has almost no side margins.
